title: Amethyst Gravity: Sculkified
description: Infuses the power of the sculk to create a more late game experience with Amethyst Gravity
body:
Amethyste Gravity is a fun mod but it has a major down side!!! 
It is too easy to access in early game... so this modpack does a few things to change that 

- Removes Anchor Recipes [admin only now]
- Added Sculk power into gravity blocks!!! [Wardens are now targets >:D]
- Need more Amethyst to make gravity platforms now!!!

Modpacks this is in :D
> Celeste Create Hell
